_comment: Card CB-Q leg C — the STRICT TWO-SIGNAL 305-station arm (user-directed 2026-08-11).
GPS-only, dual frequency, ONE channel per band network-wide: C1C + C2W and nothing
else.  Delta vs _golden305_gps is processing.signal_priorities (the STRING form
'WCSLXPYMIQ' expands to every attribute on every band and puts C1W AHEAD of C1C;
the ARRAY form below is a whitelist, because decideConstellationCanonicals only
considers priority-list entries as canonical candidates — PppModel.cpp:462) plus
frequency_mode all -> dual, which is now honest: bands 1 and 2 are all there is.
WHY, for this card: SPEC_cb_carry_physical_q measures the emitted OSBs DRIFTING
(log-log slope 0.99, metres per pass) and locates the drift in the UNPINNED
inter-channel directions — C1W-C1C 2.90 m / 5.3 h though it is a hardware
constant, C2X-C2W, C5Q/C5X worst of all — while the PINNED IF(C1C,C2W) reads
0.003 cm and the iono-confounded GF direction is the QUIETEST.  With exactly two
signals per satellite the per-sat IF pin consumes one of the two columns and the
sum-to-zero datum takes the level, so every drifting inter-channel direction is
removed BY CONSTRUCTION.  This arm asks what the code-bias channel does when only
the estimable direction is left.
STATION COVERAGE: all 304 rosters (303 in-network + WTZZ) were header-scanned for
C1C/L1C/C2W/L2W and ALL FOUR are present in every one, so the 'strict coverage'
filter drops nothing and the roster is unchanged.  The multi-channel columns exist
because stations track those signals IN ADDITION, not because coverage is ragged.
(Header presence is not data presence; the producer's own signalAdmitted network
coverage gate and the run-end counters are the check that matters.)
PRE-REGISTERED RISK — this may produce ZERO SOLUTION EPOCHS.  Odijk et al. 2016:
with two frequencies the satellite code biases are not estimable (IF -> clock, GF
-> ionosphere), and _golden63_gps_1h_dual reproduced exactly that (121/121
withheld, exit 1).  The 305-sta dual probe SOLVED with n_cb = 102 — but that arm
still had >2 signals across the network, which is precisely what this one removes.
The SH iono constraint is what can break the GF confounding; whether it does at
deg-15 with 303 stations is the question.  RECOGNITION: 'Network (D0) TOW' lines
= 0, PD fold ran on ZERO epochs, 'the shared datum is under-specified'.  If it
withholds, the conformant two-frequency arm is estimate_sat_code_bias: false.
READ FIRST, before any timing: the 'Canonical signals locked for GPS' line (must
be C1C/C2W only), n_cb + gauge-row count, stations admitted, and the emitted B
record signal set.  Standing invariant #4.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: frequency_mode and the signal set change the state vector.
60 epochs at 30 s.  Runs only if the 20-epoch arm is clean.
